non_blocking_findings.summary: Anonymous root visits take a needless protected-route round trip (frontend/app/page.tsx:4): `/` always redirects to `/dashboard` instead of deciding between the shell and `/login`.

Desktop navigation always causes a post-mount layout shift (frontend/src/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:35): `navOpen` initializes to `false` for every render, while the viewport effect changes it to `true` after mount on desktop.
